instruction: Use the right arm to set the small round drinkable cup on the smooth round plate for serving.

source.instruction: Use the right arm to set the small round drinkable cup on the smooth round plate for serving.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the container, which was at x = +28 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper to (34, -8, 94.5) pointing down to align over the cup.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+3, +11, +0) cm, now 6 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the container

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (34, -8, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right gripper down to z=85 around the cup rim.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, -1, -9) cm, now 5 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the container

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (33, -10, 85) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Close right gripper completely to grasp the cup.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 5 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the container; closed the gripper (opening 0.08: holding the container)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (33, -10, 85) opening 0.08; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift right arm to z=95 and align pitch downwards.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +1, +10) cm, now 5 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the container

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (33, -8, 95) opening 0.08; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right arm left and slightly back toward (11, -12, 97) over the plate.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-22, -4, +2) cm, now 5 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the container

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (12, -12, 97) opening 0.08; table z = 74
frames.plan: Adjust roll and pitch orientation to level the cup.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 6 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the container

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (11, -12, 97) opening 0.08; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower cup onto the plate to z=88, then open gripper to release.
